notes: Zero applies only to recurring domestic coal-power fly ash. Legacy stock and imports remain explicit separate channels.
Do not infer slag tonnes from steel capacity without a governed slag/hot-metal factor. EAF transition reduces BF-linked supply but does not make it zero by 2030/2035.
Published 1.1 Mt is cement containing activated clay and 22% is a maximum incorporation rate; never multiply them to claim actual clay supply.
No credit until annual recoverable cement-grade fines are linked to governed demolition/renovation flows.
ACT identifies limestone filler as scalable constituent; national tonnes are not assumed unlimited.
Coal use for electricity is prohibited from 2030; zero applies to recurring domestic coal-power fly ash only.
1.10643 Mt is upstream externally sold blast-furnace slag, not a cement-grade GGBS allocation. Future supply must decline with BF replacement rather than stay frozen.
Physical steelmaking slag may exist, but PAS SCM credit is zero until cementitious performance, safety, approvals and scale are demonstrated.
Ecocem is developing ACT formulations using calcined clays; this is not evidence of a quantified Dutch domestic clay stream.
No credit until annual recoverable cement-grade fines are linked to governed demolition/renovation flows.
First market-ready ACT is expected to use GGBS and limestone fillers; national limestone tonnes are not assumed unlimited.
